sources.snippet: A fine-tuned model might show a 12-point gain on a target task, only to suffer catastrophic forgetting dropping 6 points on GSM8K and suffering an 11% rise in harmful completions. True generalization increasingly requires reinforcement learning (RL/GRPO) rather than simple SFT. Ultimately, a fine-tuned artifact is rarely a durable moat.
